submitted.rationale: XRD shows two main phases along the line. Phase A (Q ≈ 1.87, 2.37, 2.65, 3.56, 4.19, 4.43) is dominant on the Sb-rich side and is almost pure at idx 24. Phase B (Q ≈ 2.04, 3.33, 3.90) is dominant on the Pb-rich side, with PbO-like peaks also present at idx 0. EQE rose with the phase A fraction: idx 4 (mostly B) gave 0.0139%, idx 15 (mixed A+B) gave 0.0360%, and idx 24 (nearly pure A) gave 0.0392%. Idx 24 is the best composition measured.

rejected.reason: Mostly phase B; EQE 0.0139%, about 3x lower than idx 24.
Mixed phase A+B; EQE 0.0360%, slightly below idx 24.
XRD shows phase B plus PbO impurity; that side of the line scored poorly (idx 4), so no EQE measurement was spent on it.
